name: Blood Upon Stone, Lesser
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 3, alchemist 3, druid 3, occultist 3, shaman 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 0 ft.
Target one Medium stone object
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cast the spell and cut your hand dripping blood onto the stone beneath you.

You take 1 damage that cannot be reduced by any resistance or damage reduction, and the stone comes to life as a Medium animated object for the duration or until it is destroyed.

The animated stone immediately attacks whomever or whatever you initially designate and follows your commands.

Lesser blood upon stone, can be made permanent with a permanency spell with a minimum caster level of 9th and 5,000 gp.

Blood Upon Stone

School transmutation; Level adept 4, alchemist 4, druid 4, occultist 4, shaman 4, witch 4
Target one Large stone object

This spell functions as lesser blood upon stone except you create a Large animated object. This can also be made permanent with the permanency spell with a minimum caster level of 11th and 8,000 gp.

Blood Upon Stone, Greater

School transmutation; Level adept 5, alchemist 5, druid 5, occultist 5, shaman 5, witch 5
Target one Huge stone object

This spell functions as lesser blood upon stone except you create a Huge animated object. This can also be made permanent with the permanency spell with a minimum caster level of 13th and 11,000 gp.
